The admin countdown for pending orders is the `OrderCountdown` component in `components/admin/OrderCountdown.tsx`. I found it by searching, and I haven't opened the file to check how it computes the time.

The admin orders page, `app/admin/orders/page.tsx`, imports it at line 45. It renders `<OrderCountdown expiresAt={ord.expires_at} createdAt={ord.created_at} />` at lines 778, 1073 and 1578, which look like separate views of the orders list.

The `fullstack_find` atlas tool was denied permission, so this came from Grep and Glob instead. The other countdowns I came across (the public checkout modals, the reseller top-up modal and the supplier portal) aren't in the admin area.
